select g.*, ar1.approve_status, if(gu.user_count is null,0,gu.user_count) user_count FROM `group` g left join ( select * from approve_record ar where ar.id in( select max(id) as id from approve_record a where a.flow_tag = 'upcUserGroup' group by approve_target_id ) )ar1 on g.id = ar1.approve_target_id left join ( select group_id,count(*) as user_count from groups_users group by group_id )gu on g.id = gu.group_id where status != 2
and (g.group_name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or g.created_user like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') )
order by g.created_time desc

select count(1) FROM `group` g where status != 2
and (g.group_name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or g.created_user like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') )
select g.* FROM `group` g where g.status!=2 and g.id=#{groupId}

select g.*, gu.user_id FROM `group` g join groups_users gu on g.status =1 and gu.group_id =g.id where gu.user_id in
#{item}

select distinct g.* FROM `group` g join groups_users gu on g.status =1 and gu.group_id =g.id join `user` u on gu.user_id = u.id where u.username in
